text: 기준시점(유방절제술 시술일)부터 사망·자료 관찰 종료 중 최초까지 추적 (추적기간: 17년)
gold: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4066543)) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '17' YEAR AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '17' YEAR ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '17_YEAR_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "유방절제술" → procedure_occurrence.procedure_concept_id IN (4066543)
테이블(컬럼 전체):
  # death(사망) PK=None
    - person_id (환자 ID) integer  [→person]
    - death_date (사망 일자) date
    - death_datetime (사망 일시) datetime
    - death_type_concept_id (사망 유형 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
  # observation_period(관찰 기간) PK=observation_period_id
    - observation_period_id (관찰 기간 ID) integer  [PK]
    - person_id (환자 ID) integer  [→person]
    - observation_period_start_date (관찰 기간 시작 일자) date
    - observation_period_end_date (관찰 기간 종료 일자) date
    - period_type_concept_id (기간 유형 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
  # person(환자) PK=person_id
    - person_id (환자 ID) integer  [PK]
    - gender_concept_id (성별 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
    - birth_datetime (출생 일시) datetime
    - race_concept_id (인종 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
  # procedure_occurrence(시술 발생) PK=procedure_occurrence_id
    - procedure_occurrence_id (시술 발생 ID) integer  [PK]
    - person_id (환자 ID) integer  [→person]
    - procedure_concept_id (시술 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
    - procedure_date (시술 일자) date
    - procedure_datetime (시술 일시) datetime
    - procedure_type_concept_id (시술 유형 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
    - quantity (수량) integer
    - visit_occurrence_id (방문 발생 ID) integer  [→visit_occurrence]
    - procedure_source_concept_id (시술 원천 개념 ID) integer  [→concept]
조인:
  - death.person_id = person.person_id
  - observation_period.person_id = person.person_id
  - procedure_occurrence.person_id = person.person_id
